h1: The 5 Best Electric Pruning Shears With Two Batteries of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Two-Battery Pruning Shears: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the 5 best electric pruning shears that ship with two batteries, compared on cutting diameter, runtime and spare blades.
summary: The ANTTCTIG 2.75 inch model is our top pick for its widest cut and two included batteries with spare blades. The ANTTCTIG 2.56 inch version is a lower-cost sibling, and the KOMOK 1.65 inch model is the one that states a runtime. The Upgraded 1.4 inch shears are the cheapest way to get two batteries and an extra blade.
intro: The usual pruning shears mistake is shopping by battery count and ignoring cutting diameter. Two batteries double your working time, but if the jaws top out at 1.2 inches you will still reach for a handsaw on the first thick branch.

We kept only models whose listings state two included batteries and ranked them by stated cutting diameter, runtime, spare blades and extras such as a brushless motor or LCD. These are paper rankings from the listing data, so verify the capacity against your thickest branch before you buy.

products.name: ANTTCTIG Electric Pruning Shears, 2.75'' Cut, 2 Batteries & Spare Blades
products.verdict: The largest cutting diameter here, with two batteries and spare blades in the box.
products.description:
The ANTTCTIG 2.75 inch model has the widest stated cutting diameter in this ranking at 2.75 inches, and the listing includes two batteries and spare blades. It sits in the $50-100 bucket.

It takes first place because capacity is what separates real pruners from trimming tools, and it beats every rival here on that number while still bundling the spares. Its drawback against the KOMOK pair is that the listing gives no stated runtime figure.

Best for thick branches and larger yards. Skip it if you need a published runtime before you commit.
products.skipIf: You need a stated runtime figure.

products.name: ANTTCTIG Electric Pruning Shears, 2.56'' Cut, 2 Batteries & Spare Blades
products.verdict: Nearly the same kit with a 2.56 inch cut.
products.description:
This ANTTCTIG variant cuts up to 2.56 inches and also includes two batteries and spare blades. It shares the $50-100 price bucket with the top pick.

It ranks second because it gives up only about 0.19 inches of capacity compared with the 2.75 inch version, which rarely matters in practice. The listing positions it as the lower-priced option of the two.

Best for gardeners who want the same kit for a bit less. Skip it if every extra fraction of an inch counts.
pros: Lower cost than the top pick
products.idealFor: Buyers who want the ANTTCTIG kit for less.
products.skipIf: You need the maximum cutting capacity.

products.name: KOMOK Electric Pruning Shears, Professional Cordless Electric Pruners, 1.65" (42mm) Cutting Diameter
products.verdict: A named 8 to 10 hour runtime with two 2Ah batteries.
products.description:
The KOMOK 1.65 inch (42mm) model comes with two 2Ah batteries and a stated runtime of 8 to 10 hours.

It ranks third because the 1.65 inch cut is well under the ANTTCTIG pair, and it costs more. What you get in exchange is a concrete runtime figure, which neither ANTTCTIG listing offers.

Best for buyers who want a published runtime for long pruning days. Skip it if you need to cut thick limbs.
products.idealFor: Long pruning sessions where runtime matters.

products.name: Upgraded Electric Pruning Shears, 1.4" Cutting Diameter Cordless Pruner with LCD Display, Brushless Motor, 2x2.0Ah Batteries & Extra Blade
products.verdict: Two batteries, an extra blade, a brushless motor and an LCD at the lowest cost.
products.description:
These shears cut up to 1.4 inches and include two 2.0Ah batteries, an extra blade, a brushless motor and an LCD display. They fall in the $25-50 bucket, the lowest here.

They rank fourth because the cut is smaller than the ANTTCTIG pair, but the feature list is stronger than the price implies, since a brushless motor and an LCD are unusual at this level.

Best for light garden work on a budget. Skip it if you need a wide cutting range.
products.idealFor: Light pruning for the least money.

products.name: KOMOK Electric Pruning Shears, Cordless Electric Pruner Battery Operated Tree Branch Cutter, 1.2 inch (30mm) Cutting Diameter
products.verdict: The same stated runtime with a smaller 1.2 inch cut.
products.description:
The KOMOK 1.2 inch (30mm) model includes two 2Ah batteries and the same stated 8 to 10 hour runtime as its bigger sibling, in the $100-200 bucket.

It ranks last because its cut is the smallest here while the price bucket matches the 1.65 inch KOMOK. The cheaper Upgraded shears also give you a 1.4 inch cut for less.

Best for fruit trees, roses and light shrubs. Skip it if you want more capacity for the price.
pros: Suited to roses and fruit trees

whatMatters.detail: Cutting diameter is the thickest branch the jaws can close on, and it ranges from 1.2 to 2.75 inches here. A tool rated below your thickest branch will stall or jam. Check the exact inch or millimeter figure in the title and leave margin.
Capacity is measured in amp-hours, and a 2Ah pack holds less than a larger one. Two packs mean you swap rather than stop to charge. Look for the Ah rating of each pack in the listing.

Runtime is how long a charge lasts under light work, and most listings leave it out. The KOMOK models state 8 to 10 hours, which is a real comparison point. If the listing gives no figure, treat the battery as an unknown.
Blades dull and nick, especially on dirty or woody cuts. A listing that bundles spares saves a separate purchase. Check the contents list for the number of extra blades.
A brushless motor typically runs cooler and wastes less power than a brushed one. It is a useful extra but not a substitute for cutting capacity. Look for the word brushless in the specs.

faq.q: Do the batteries fit other tools?
faq.a: The listings do not say, so assume the packs are specific to each pruner. Check the product page for compatibility before buying spares.

faq.q: What is the biggest buying mistake?
faq.a: Choosing by battery count alone. Two batteries mean nothing if the cutting diameter is below your thickest branch.

faq.q: Is the ANTTCTIG worth it over the Upgraded shears?
faq.a: If you cut branches thicker than 1.4 inches, yes. The 2.75 inch model gives much more capacity, and the Upgraded shears are for light work.

faq.q: How do I start using electric shears?
faq.a: Charge both batteries, fit one, and test a cut on a thin branch. Keep the blade clean and sharp for consistent cuts.

faq.q: Do I need to replace the blades?
faq.a: Eventually, yes. The ANTTCTIG listings include spare blades, and the Upgraded shears include one extra blade.
Dead wood is harder on blades, so use a model with spare blades and stay under the stated cutting diameter.

finalTake: The ANTTCTIG 2.75 inch shears are the best electric pruners with two batteries here, offering the widest cut plus spare blades. The 2.56 inch version is the sensible step down, and the KOMOK 1.65 inch is for buyers who want a stated runtime. Start by measuring your thickest branch, and let that number choose the model.
